title.narrative: Sustain Niue Air Services: Runway overlay, apron renewal and airfield ground lighting

description.narrative: This Activity aims to bring the Hanan International Airport's paved surfaces and lighting systems into compliance with relevant aviation standards. The investigation and design has been completed. The current phase is funding for a construction contractor and engineering supervision of the delivery for the pavement overlay and lighting upgrade.
